# Implementation

Details about the implementation of the `rna-score` CLI tool's scripts, based on which the library is also built.

```
src/
├── access_rna_structures.py
├── extract_distances.py
├── kde_training.py
├── plot_scores.py
├── score_structures.py
├── train.py
└── utils
    ├── structure_io.py
    └── validate_pdb_files.py
```
